case_title: Carrier delay is real, but still inside the promise window
exception_description: Shipment CR-8120 is on a promised-date route. The primary carrier reports a 4-hour line-haul delay, but the latest ETA still arrives before the customer promise. AI recommends keeping the existing carrier rather than switching.
layer1_visible: Shipment CR-8120 is on a promised-date route. The primary carrier reports a 4-hour line-haul delay, but the latest ETA still arrives before the customer promise. AI recommends keeping the existing carrier rather than switching.
detail_expand: Eight cartons are already manifested and staged for the current pickup. Changing carriers would require relabeling and a new pickup slot. No broader network escalation beyond the current delay has been issued. The case tests whether participants can tolerate medium disruption without reflexively overriding the AI on limited evidence this time.
ai_recommendation: AI recommends keeping the existing carrier because the promise window remains intact and switching creates avoidable relabeling and pickup cost.
